economy.summary: His campaign platform states that Pennsylvanians should not work for lower wages than surrounding states and supports a $15 minimum wage.

taxes.summary: His campaign platform calls for providing property tax relief, stopping tax breaks for big businesses, and closing the Delaware loophole that lets corporations avoid state income taxes.
taxes.short: Supports property tax relief; proposes closing the Delaware loophole.

abortion.summary: His campaign platform states a commitment to protect reproductive freedom.
abortion.short: Says he will protect reproductive freedom.

education.summary: His campaign platform advocates ensuring children have a safe, equitable, rigorous and fully funded public education, and calls to recruit, train, and deploy a diverse pool of teachers.
education.short: Supports fully funded public education; recruiting diverse teachers.

healthcare.summary: His campaign platform states that healthcare is a right not a privilege, with a stated goal of affordable physical and mental health care for every Pennsylvanian.
healthcare.short: Says healthcare is a right; supports affordable care for all.

energy.summary: His campaign platform calls for strengthening state oversight by increasing funding and staffing of the Department of Environmental Protection and for a moratorium on industry practices that are meaningfully detrimental to air, water, or soil.
energy.short: Supports more DEP funding; proposes moratorium on harmful practices.

guns.summary: His campaign platform supports background checks for all sales, banning automatic weapons, and restricting 3D-printed guns, and calls to restore local rights and hold the NRA accountable.
guns.short: Supports universal background checks and banning automatic weapons.
